'''2008 Washington State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 19 July 2008 at the Algona-Pacific Library, 255 Ellingson Road, Pacific, Washington, with [[Chris Wirfs]] as tournament director and [[Steve Harpster]] and [[Michael Erisman]] as additional tournament directors; all three also played.<ref name="sf-20536-314642">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=314642#p314642 Washington State Championship - discussion], itcouldbewirfs (Chris Wirfs), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181603/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start120.html Internet Archive]</ref> Seven players took part, and [[Steve Harpster]] won the final confrontation against [[Jacob Vawter]] to become state champion.<ref name="sf-20536-316567">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316567#p316567 Washington State Championship - discussion], mserisman (Michael Erisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181647/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-20536-316602">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316602#p316602 Washington State Championship - discussion], mserisman (Michael Erisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181728/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref> He received the bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="sf-20536-316823">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316823#p316823 Washington State Championship - discussion], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181913/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start180.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organization ==

In early May 2008 [[Ryan French]] announced that the state championship would be a constructed event rather than a [[Cube]] draft.<ref name="sf-20536-299412">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=299412#p299412 Washington State Championship - discussion], Shadow 13 (Ryan French), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (4 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125182122/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start40.html Internet Archive]</ref> On 1 June Erisman reported that he had booked the Bellevue Library, but that it held at most 16 people, and he urged a later date and a larger venue.<ref name="sf-20536-304919">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=304919#p304919 Washington State Championship - discussion], mserisman (Michael Erisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125182234/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref> On 21 June 2008 Harpster announced Saturday 19 July at the Algona-Pacific Library, after the weekend of 26–27 July could not be booked, with himself as tournament director, Wirfs as assistant tournament director, a $5 entry fee and money prizes.<ref name="sf-20536-308684">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=308684#p308684 Washington State Championship - discussion], Harpster (Steve Harpster), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125182234/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start60.html Internet Archive]</ref> Wirfs later explained that he and Harpster had picked a July date because no date, venue or prize support had been settled by 19 June.<ref name="sf-20536-316708">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316708#p316708 Washington State Championship - discussion], itcouldbewirfs (Chris Wirfs), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181913/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start180.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Wirfs's announcement of 12 July 2008 promised the winner a bye into Day 2 of the World Championship and a glass trophy "proclaiming our 2008 Washington State Champion", with further prizes of up to 30 rares, 30 boosters, tournament foils, EPP/EJP/ECC boxes and virtual card cut sheets.<ref name="sf-20536-314642" /> After the event Erisman listed the prize support as packs of Theed, Death Star II, Tatooine, Special Edition, Hoth, Premiere black border and Cloud City, rares, tournament foils and Jabba's expanded decks.<ref name="sf-20536-316634">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316634#p316634 Washington State Championship - discussion], mserisman (Michael Erisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181728/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Algona-Pacific Library, 255 Ellingson Road, Pacific, Washington<ref name="sf-20536-314642" />
* '''Dates:''' 19 July 2008<ref name="sf-20536-314642" />
* '''Time:''' 9:30 am – 5:00 pm<ref name="sf-20536-314642" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, under the Players Committee's Championship Level Event Rules; decklists required, with the first card listed as the starting card for the whole day<ref name="sf-20536-314642" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5<ref name="sf-20536-314642" />
* '''Tournament directors:''' [[Chris Wirfs]]; additional tournament directors [[Steve Harpster]] and [[Michael Erisman]]<ref name="sf-20536-314642" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Harpster]]<ref name="sf-20536-316602" />

== Results ==

Erisman posted the final Swiss standings on 20 July 2008, with Harpster and Jacob Vawter tied on points for the final confrontation.<ref name="sf-20536-316597">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316597#p316597 Washington State Championship - discussion], mserisman (Michael Erisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181728/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref> In the final confrontation Harpster's Agents deck beat Jacob Vawter's Hidden Base by 28, and Vawter's Ralltiir Ops beat Harpster's Boss Nass deck by 10, making Harpster the 2008 Washington state champion.<ref name="sf-20536-316602" /> Erisman wrote that one game separated places one to five.<ref name="sf-20536-316634" />

Erisman also posted game-by-game results for all seven players.<ref name="sf-20536-316605">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316605#p316605 Washington State Championship - discussion], mserisman (Michael Erisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181728/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref> Erisman played Hidden Base Quads with Kirdo/Sandwhirl and Imperial Entanglements, each going 2–1.<ref name="sf-20536-316598">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316598#p316598 Washington State Championship - discussion], mserisman (Michael Erisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181728/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref> Harpster played an Underwater Revo deck, which he credited to Reid S., and an AOBS deck of his own design; he wrote that Wirfs had played "damn near same decks" as his.<ref name="sf-20536-316619">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316619#p316619 Washington State Championship - discussion], Harpster (Steve Harpster), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181728/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref> The decklists of all seven players were attached to the forum topic as PDF files (Chris Wirfs, Isaac Vawter, Jacob Vawter, Kyle Krueger, Michael Erisman, Phil Aasen and Steve Harpster, Dark and Light for each). Those files were not preserved.{{Mystery|question=What were the seven players' full Dark and Light decklists at the 2008 Washington State Championship|section=Score sheets, decks and listings that were not preserved|type=deck}}<ref name="sf-20536-316764">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316764#p316764 Washington State Championship - discussion], Michael Erisman (mserisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181913/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start180.html Internet Archive]</ref>
